Yes! According to the crop catalog, **peppers (Carmen variety)** have a `sun_preference` of **full sun**. So they'll want the sunniest spot you can give them. 🌞

A few other details from their catalog row, in case they're helpful:
- **Frost sensitive**: yes — keep them protected from late frosts
- **Watering interval**: every 3 days
- **Days to harvest**: 60–80 days

Let me know if you have any other questions about your peppers!
